description: This file defines the Serializer class for serializing and deserializing HTTP request messages within the Laminas Diactoros library, including methods for converting request objects to strings and parsing request strings into request objects.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: Final class providing serialization and deserialization of HTTP request messages, extending AbstractSerializer.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a request string into a Request object by writing the string into a stream and parsing it.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Converts a StreamInterface object into a Request object, parsing the request line, headers, and body.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes a RequestInterface object into a string representation of the HTTP request message.

methods.name: getRequestLine
methods.description: Extracts and parses the request line from a stream, returning method, target, and version.

methods.name: createUriFromRequestTarget
methods.description: Creates a Uri object based on the request target string, handling authority and absolute URI forms.
